name: Oosaki Yutaka
source:
Shuichi's superior and the head of the Sales Department.

He has looked after Shuichi ever since the latter joined the company.

For the most part, he is a dependable superior when it comes to work. However, he occasionally says or does things that completely contradict his previous statements and actions, leaving his staff confused and frustrated.

When dealing with clients and the company's upper management, he behaves like a sycophantic yes-man. Consequently, some of his subordinates privately refer to him as a "weathercock" (someone who changes their position depending on which way the wind is blowing).

He has a wife and one child. His son is currently attending university and living on his own.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
